International Gas Product Shipping JSC Reports Stable Growth in Latest Financial Results

International Gas Product Shipping JSC, a key player in Vietnam’s Transportation & Logistics industry, has reported steady performance in its latest quarterly financial results, reflecting ongoing demand and expansion in the domestic gas shipping sector. The company posted a year-on-year revenue increase of 8.2%, reaching VND 1.25 trillion for the quarter ending March 31, with net profit advancing 5.7% to VND 158 billion.

Company representatives attributed the growth to robust demand for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) transportation and heightened activity at key Vietnamese ports. “Our operational efficiency and focus on safety have enabled us to capitalize on favorable market conditions,” said Le Van Hoang, Chief Financial Officer of International Gas Product Shipping JSC. “We continue to invest in fleet modernization and training to maintain our competitive edge.”

The firm’s improved utilization rate—rising to 89% compared to last year’s 84%—has been highlighted by industry analysts as a sign of strong management and ongoing market opportunity. “The company’s performance is a positive signal for the sector, especially as Vietnam’s industrial and household gas demand continues to rise,” noted Nguyen Thi Thu, a transport sector analyst at Mekong Market Insights.

Vietnam’s government has recently emphasized the importance of secure and efficient gas product logistics, as part of broader energy security goals. Trade associations welcomed the results, with the Vietnam Logistics Association commenting that “stable growth in gas shipping underpins industrial development.”

International Gas Product Shipping JSC said it would maintain its current investment strategy, with plans for gradual fleet expansion and digitalization initiatives to further enhance service quality in the coming quarters.
